d:
Watch the song video of lord Ganpati. The song, sung by Shankar Mahadevan & Vishal Dadlani, will leave you spellbound with its haunting melody and evocative lyrics.
Join us on this spiritual journey as we celebrate the divine grace of Lord Ganesha and seek His blessings for a life filled with happiness, peace, and harmony.
Song Credits
Song: Shambhu Sutaya
Singers: Shankar Mahadevan, Vishal Dadlani
Composer: Sachin Jigar
Lyricist: Mayur Puri
Directed by: Remo D'Souza
